Bridge to the Python eyetrajectoriespy API

et_bridge.Rd

Access public Python exports while keeping fitted Python objects intact.

Usage

et_python()

et_python_version()

et_call(name, ..., .namespace = c("root", "workflows"), .convert = FALSE)

et_to_r(x)

Arguments

name

Single public exported callable name.

...

Arguments passed to the Python callable.

.namespace

Python export namespace: "root" or "workflows".

.convert

Convert returned Python objects to R, where supported.

x

A Python object to convert explicitly.

Value

et_python() returns a Python module object; et_python_version() returns a version string; et_call() returns the Python result unless .convert = TRUE; et_to_r() requests reticulate conversion.

Details

Only names in the selected Python module's __all__ are accepted. Python objects that are not representable as ordinary R objects remain Python proxies. Loading the R package does not initialize Python.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(eyetrajectories)
et_python_version()
et_call("simulate_planar_trajectories", n_participants = 4L,
        trials_per_participant = 2L, random_state = 7L)
} # }
